best_for: People who use ChatGPT every day on a Windows PC or Mac and want it one shortcut away, plus Codex for working in local code folders.

points.title: One shortcut away
points.text: On a Mac, Option+Space opens a quick chat bar. On Windows, Alt+Space opens a companion window where you can ask, upload files or start a new chat, and the shortcut can be changed if it clashes.

points.title: Chat, Work and Codex in one app
points.text: The current desktop app puts Chat and Work under one toggle and Codex in its own view. Codex keeps its own history and can work inside local folders and repositories, which the web and mobile apps cannot.

points.title: Classic app still around
points.text: The earlier desktop app is now called ChatGPT Classic. It keeps getting model and security updates, but new agent features land only in the new app.

points.title: Plan limits apply
points.text: OpenAI says Chat, Work and Codex are available on every plan, including Free. On Free, uploads, image creation, voice, deep research and Codex use are limited.

points.title: Recent systems only
points.text: OpenAI's help page lists macOS 14 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel, and says it will not release a version for older macOS. Windows builds are MSIX packages for x64 and Arm64.

points.title: Versions kept
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 17 versions; macOS lists only the current release. There is no Linux app.

sources.label: Moving to the new desktop app
